table.name: frpm
table.purpose: California Free or Reduced Price Meals (FRPM) eligibility data per school for the 2014-2015 academic year: enrollment and counts/percentages of students eligible for free meals and free/reduced price meals under the National School Lunch Program (NSLP) and the School Supplemental Program (SSP). One row per school; joins one-to-one to the schools table via the CDS code.

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit County-District-School (CDS) code uniquely identifying each school; primary key, references schools.col_001.

col_002.name: academic_year
col_002.description: Academic year of the data ('2014-2015'); constant in this table.

col_003.name: county_code
col_003.description: Two-digit California county code (1-58); pairs with county name in col_006.

col_004.name: district_code
col_004.description: Five-digit district code portion of the CDS code (e.g., 64733 = Los Angeles Unified).

col_005.name: school_code
col_005.description: Seven-digit school code portion of the CDS code; '0000000' (45 rows) corresponds to district-level 'District Office' rows.

col_006.name: county_name
col_006.description: California county name (Los Angeles, San Diego, etc.).

col_007.name: district_name
col_007.description: School district or administrative entity name (e.g., 'Los Angeles Unified').

col_008.name: school_name
col_008.description: School name; 'District Office' for district-level rows.

col_009.name: district_type
col_009.description: Type of district/administrative body: Unified School District, Elementary School District, High School District, County Office of Education, State Board of Education, Non-School Locations.

col_010.name: school_level_type
col_010.description: School level/type category, e.g., Elementary Schools (Public), High Schools (Public), Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public), Continuation High Schools, Alternative Schools of Choice.

col_011.name: educational_option_type
col_011.description: Educational option/program type: Traditional, Continuation School, Alternative School of Choice, Community Day School, Special Education School, Juvenile Court School, etc.

col_012.name: provision_type
col_012.description: NSLP meal provision alternative the school operates under (Provision 1/2/3, Breakfast Provision 2, CEP = Community Eligibility Provision, Multiple Provision Types); null for most schools (no special provision).

col_013.name: is_charter_school
col_013.description: Flag indicating whether the school is a charter school (1 = yes, 1167 rows; matches the non-null count of charter number col_014 and charter funding type col_015).

col_014.name: charter_school_number
col_014.description: Charter school number (state-issued), populated only for charter schools (null for non-charters).

col_015.name: charter_funding_type
col_015.description: Charter funding model: 'Directly funded' or 'Locally funded'; populated only for charter schools.

col_017.name: low_grade
col_017.description: Lowest grade served at the school ('K' = kindergarten, 'P' likely pre-kindergarten, digits = grade).

col_018.name: high_grade
col_018.description: Highest grade served at the school (1-13, 'K'); 13 likely corresponds to ungraded/transition programs.

col_019.name: enrollment_nslp
col_019.description: Enrollment of students in grades K-12 where the National School Lunch Program applies.

col_020.name: free_meals_count
col_020.description: Number of students eligible for free meals (NSLP-eligible enrollment).

col_021.name: free_meals_percent
col_021.description: Percent (0-1) of NSLP-applicable enrollment eligible for free meals; equals col_020 / col_019.

col_022.name: frpm_count
col_022.description: Number of students eligible for free or reduced price meals (NSLP).

col_023.name: frpm_percent
col_023.description: Percent (0-1) of NSLP-applicable enrollment eligible for free or reduced price meals; equals col_022 / col_019.

col_024.name: enrollment_ssp
col_024.description: Enrollment of students in grades where the School Supplemental Program (state meal program) applies; slightly larger than NSLP enrollment.

col_025.name: free_meals_ssp_count
col_025.description: Number of students eligible for free meals under the SSP.

col_026.name: free_meals_ssp_percent
col_026.description: Percent (0-1) of SSP-applicable enrollment eligible for free meals; equals col_025 / col_024.

col_027.name: frpm_ssp_count
col_027.description: Number of students eligible for free or reduced price meals under the SSP.

col_028.name: frpm_ssp_percent
col_028.description: Percent (0-1) of SSP-applicable enrollment eligible for free or reduced price meals; equals col_027 / col_024.

table.name: satscores
table.purpose: California school/district-level SAT (and possibly ACT) score averages and test-taker counts, keyed by CDS code, one row per school or district entity.

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit CDS (County-District-School) code identifying the school or district; primary key, one-to-one with schools table.

col_002.name: record_type
col_002.description: Level of the record: 'S' = school, 'D' = district.

col_003.name: school_name
col_003.description: School name; null for district-level ('D') rows.

col_004.name: district_name
col_004.description: School district (or county office of education) name.

col_006.name: enrollment_grade_12
col_006.description: Number of grade-12 students (enrollment); larger than test-taker counts in the same row. Alternative reading: total enrollment across grades, but grade-12 fits the SAT context best.

col_007.name: sat_test_takers
col_007.description: Number of students who took the SAT; 0 or small counts common, always <= col_006. Alternative reading: number of seniors tested in a specific cycle, but test-taker count fits best.

col_008.name: avg_sat_reading
col_008.description: Average SAT reading/critical reading score (range ~308-653, plausible SAT section scale). Alternative reading: average combined score, but single-section average fits the scale better.

col_009.name: avg_sat_math
col_009.description: Average SAT math score (range ~289-699, plausible SAT section scale). Alternative reading: average ACT math score, but SAT scale fits best.

col_010.name: avg_sat_writing
col_010.description: Average SAT writing score (range ~312-671, plausible SAT section scale). Alternative reading: average essay subscore, but full writing section average fits the scale.

col_011.name: act_test_takers
col_011.description: Number of ACT test takers; null when no scores reported. Could alternatively be number meeting a benchmark, but test-taker count fits best.

table.name: schools
table.purpose: California Department of Education public school directory: one row per school/site (active, closed, merged, pending) with its identifying codes, location, contacts, type/grade classifications and administrative metadata. Joined one-to-one by CDS code to frpm (Free/Reduced Price Meals) and satscores (SAT scores).

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit CDS (County-District-School) code, unique primary key; joins to frpm and satscores.

col_002.name: district_code
col_002.description: 7-digit district (LEA) code; first two digits are county code (06x = Sacramento region etc.). 5.8% null (schools not assigned to a district).

col_003.name: school_code
col_003.description: 5-digit school code within district (part of CDS code); null for district-level/COE rows.

col_004.name: status_type
col_004.description: School status: Active, Closed, Merged, or Pending.

col_005.name: county
col_005.description: County name (California counties: Los Angeles, Butte, Marin, etc.).

col_006.name: district
col_006.description: District / LEA name (e.g., Los Angeles Unified, county offices of education).

col_008.name: street_address
col_008.description: Physical street address, full words (e.g., '5A County Center Drive').

col_009.name: street_address_abbrev
col_009.description: Physical street address with abbreviated words (Dr., St., Rd.) — abbreviated variant of col_008.

col_011.name: zip
col_011.description: Physical address ZIP code, sometimes with ZIP+4.

col_013.name: mailing_street_address
col_013.description: Mailing street address (may differ from physical; PO Boxes appear).

col_014.name: mailing_street_address_abbrev
col_014.description: Mailing street address, abbreviated-word variant of col_013.

col_016.name: mailing_zip
col_016.description: Mailing address ZIP code, sometimes ZIP+4.

col_018.name: phone
col_018.description: School phone number in (area code) NNN-NNNN format.

col_019.name: nces_id
col_019.description: Sparsely populated numeric ID; values like 2881, 5000, 630100 resemble NCES school IDs, but evidence is thin.

col_021.name: open_date
col_021.description: Date the school opened; 1980-07-01 is a default/legacy date for many older schools.

col_022.name: closed_date
col_022.description: Date the school closed (populated mainly for Closed/Merged schools; 1989-06-30 is a common batch value).

col_023.name: charter_flag
col_023.description: 0/1 flag; ~11% are 1. Likely charter school indicator (charter schools are ~10% of CA schools), but the flag is not labeled.

col_024.name: charter_number
col_024.description: Charter school number (4-digit, hex-like codes such as 00D2); populated only for charter schools, consistent with col_023=1.

col_025.name: charter_funding_type
col_025.description: Charter funding model: Directly funded / Locally funded / Not in CS funding model — applies to charter schools only.

col_026.name: district_type_code
col_026.description: Two-digit code for the LEA type, paired with col_027 (54=Unified, 52=Elementary, 00=COE, 56=High School District).

col_027.name: district_type
col_027.description: LEA type label: Unified School District, Elementary School District, County Office of Education, High School District, ROC/P, etc.

col_028.name: school_type_code
col_028.description: Two-digit code for the school type/educational level, paired with col_029 (60=Elementary, 66=High, 62=Middle, 68=Continuation).

col_029.name: school_type
col_029.description: School type label: Elementary (Public), High Schools (Public), Intermediate/Middle, Continuation, Special Education, etc.

col_030.name: education_type_code
col_030.description: Code for educational option type, paired with col_031 (TRAD=Traditional, CON=Continuation, COMMDAY=Community Day, ALTSOC=Alternative School of Choice, SPEC=Special Education).

col_031.name: education_type
col_031.description: Educational option label: Traditional, Continuation School, Community Day School, etc.

col_032.name: grade_span_code
col_032.description: Code for lowest/highest grade category, paired with col_033 (ELEM, HS, UG=Ungraded, INTMIDJR, ELEMHIGH, A=Adult, PS=Preschool).

col_033.name: grade_category
col_033.description: Label of col_032: Elementary, High School, Ungraded, Intermediate/Middle/Junior High, etc.

col_034.name: low_high_grade_range
col_034.description: Grade span served, e.g., K-5, 9-12, K-8 (low-high grades).

col_035.name: low_high_grade_range_alt
col_035.description: Second grade-span field, nearly identical distribution to col_034; likely a separate reporting of the same span (e.g., current vs. offered grades). Exact distinction unresolved.

col_036.name: virtual_flag_code
col_036.description: N/P/F code; likely non-virtual / primarily virtual / fully virtual school indicator, but labels are not present.

col_038.name: latitude
col_038.description: School latitude in decimal degrees (range 32.5–44.2 matches California).

col_039.name: longitude
col_039.description: School longitude in decimal degrees (negative, -124 to -84, matches California).

col_040.name: administrator_first_name
col_040.description: First name of the school administrator/principal.

col_041.name: administrator_last_name
col_041.description: Last name of the school administrator/principal.

col_043.name: contact2_first_name
col_043.description: First name of a secondary contact (e.g., assistant principal or district contact).

col_044.name: contact2_last_name
col_044.description: Last name of a secondary contact.

col_046.name: contact3_first_name
col_046.description: First name of a third contact (very sparsely populated).

col_047.name: contact3_last_name
col_047.description: Last name of a third contact.

col_049.name: last_update_date
col_049.description: Date the record was last updated/verified in the directory (bulk dates 1999-06-24 and 2015-06-18 suggest batch imports).
